mapper.select: SELECT cc.id, cc.confession_id AS confessionId, cc.user_id AS userId, cc.content, cc.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar FROM confession_comment cc LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON cc.user_id = u.id WHERE cc.confession_id = #{confessionId} ORDER BY cc.create_time ASC
